item.title: 'Nihilist Penguin' Meme Gets Politicized As White House, DHS And Other Government Accounts Join Trend
item.description: Penguin Walking Toward Mountain or Nihilist Penguin, also known as Lonely Penguin, Wandering Penguin or Werner Herzog’s Deranged Penguin, refers to a viral video originally from the 2007 Antarctica nature documentary Encounters at the End of the World by filmmaker Werner Herzog, which features a lone penguin disoriented and heading toward the interior of the Antarctic continent to its certain death. The clip initially garnered attention online as early as 2010, spreading over the following years

item.title: 2011 'Good Noodles Everyday' Animation Resurfaces On TikTok, Inspiring Memes
item.description: Good Noodles Everyday refers to a series of video memes based on a 2018 animation by YouTuber FILNOBEP where rapper Tay-K tells Santa Clause that he wants ramen noodles for Christmas, rapping, "We gon' be eating good noodles everyday." In late January 2026, the clip of Tay-K rapping resurfaced on TikTok and became the subject of edits, including memes where the clip is played over photos and images of ramen noodles.

item.title: Mia Khalifa Says She's 'Open To It' After Denying Mr. Bean Dating Rumor
item.description: Mr. Bean Dating Mia Khalifa Rumors refers to a rumor that former adult actress Mia Khalifa is dating Rowan Atkinson, best known for his role as Mr. Bean. The rumor began spreading in mid-January 2026 on sites including X / Twitter, Instagram and TikTok, resulting in Mia Khalifa officially denying them. The rumor continued to spread after her denial.

item.title: Another Orange Cat Joins The Ranks Of Cat Memes As 'Cat Laughing'
item.description: Cat Laughing or Screaming Cat, or as it's commonly referred to, the Laughing Cat Meme, is a reaction video and meme of an orange cat shaking as it laughs and screams loudly with its ears back and its mouth open wide. It is similar to other laughing cats, such as the Cat Pointing and Laughing meme, and is typically used in videos as a funny reaction clip. item.title: Tweet About Viral 'Nutella Tricks' That School Never Taught You Inspires Memes About 'Nutella Class'
item.description: Nutella Tricks refers to memes based on a post by X / Twitter user @kaiincloud sharing a video of Instagram user the_noahnator putting a mixer into a jar of Nutella, writing, "Nutella tricks you're never taught in school." The post was made in late January 2026 and the phrase and idea of Nutella tricks being taught in school inspired memes, including recaption edits and image macros, referencing the post.
